The view requires authentication via the LoginRequiredMixin, which ensures that only logged-in users can access this functionality. The session key comes from the current user's session cookie.

candidate.guard_summary: The view is protected by LoginRequiredMixin which ensures that only authenticated users can access this functionality. The operation filters sessions to only affect those belonging to the authenticated user, preventing cross-user session deletion. candidate.risk_pattern: The view allows a logged-in user to delete all their active sessions except the current one. While this is a legitimate administrative feature, it could be misused by an attacker who has gained access to a user's session to terminate other active sessions, potentially disrupting the user's access or forcing them to re-authenticate.
